card.name: Stimulant abuse and storage warnings
card.fires_on: Small words (in, a, to, be, can, is) and periods inside warnings about stimulant tablets being abused, stolen, diverted or sold. Typical drugs are methylphenidate and amphetamine products.

modes.label: Safe storage advice
modes.description: Linking words in the instruction to keep stimulant tablets in a safe place against misuse or theft.
modes.example: Keep dextroamphetamine sulfate tablets in<< a>> safe place to protect it from theft.

modes.label: Abuse and illegal sale
modes.description: Small words and punctuation in statements that the drug can be abused, diverted or sold illegally.
